newsitem.title: USA: Western Digital's CEO to acquire stock.
newsitem.headline: Western Digital's CEO to acquire stock.

text.p: Western Digital Corp said Friday Chief Executive Chuck Haggerty has exercised stock options to purchase 258,399 shares of Western Digital common.
To cover the payment price, he has filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell 58,000 shares of Western Digital common stock.

After the exercise and sale, Mr. Haggerty will own 188,639 shares of Western Digital's common stock, compared with 36,498 in November 1995 when Western Digital held its last annual shareholders meeting.
